Edge and microcontroller-scale workloads (keyword spotting, visual wake words, and anomaly detection) aligned with MLPerf Tiny.

**Systems focus:** On-device memory budgets, small-batch latency, and sensor-style input pipelines.

|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|

| [`dscnn-kws-train`](../../benchmarks/tiny/dscnn-kws-train.qmd) | tiny | dscnn-kws | 20K | speech_commands_v2 | — | systems-only |
